warning: Every numeric limit below is a PLACEHOLDER written to exercise the engine.
Before this governs a real trade, each limit must be read from, and cited to,
the current SEBI master circular for mutual funds, the scheme's own SID, and
the fund's internal investment policy. These change, and a stale limit that
looks authoritative is worse than no limit at all.
The engine deliberately keeps limits in this file rather than in Python so a
rule change is a data edit with an effective date, and so the ruleset in force
on any past date can be reconstructed for an audit.
